reviews.text: Huele DELICIOSO y deja suuuper hidratada, para nada densa, me encantaaa, siento que mi piel en solo una semana y media de uso ha dado un giro 360, si la ven en descuento o stock no duden en comprarla !! yo me traje la que tiene olor a cítrico y es muy rico, además que les va a durar un montón xd
reviews.zh: 味道超級好聞，塗完超級補水，完全唔厚身，我好鍾意！我用咗一個半星期，感覺我嘅皮膚有咗 360 度嘅大轉變。如果見到打折或者有貨，大家都唔好猶豫，要買啊！！我揀咗柑橘味嗰款，好正，而且一定夠用好耐 xd

reviews.text: Ich habe mal bei TK-MAXX (in Polen) das Haaröl von dieser Marke und mit dem Geruch ,,Baby-Powder‘‘ gekauft und so wie bei jedem Tk-MAXX Einkauf…weiß man nie ob man das gekaufte Produkt jemals wieder in die Hände bekommt… aber siehe da.. ich hab mein Lieblings Haaröl wieder gefunden ! hab natürlich alles gekauft (Shampoo,Conditioner,Duschgel,Bodylotion usw.)
reviews.zh: 我之前喺 TK-MAXX（波蘭）買過呢個品牌嘅護髮油，香味係「Baby-Powder」（嬰兒爽身粉）。每次喺 TK-MAXX 購物都係咁，你永遠唔知道買咗嘅產品仲會唔會再搵到……不過睇吓，我又搵返我最鍾意嘅護髮油！我當然全部都買咗（洗頭水、護髮素、沐浴露、身體乳等等）。

reviews.text: This body lotion feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy finish. It keeps skin soft and hydrated throughout the day, and the scent is pleasant without being overpowering. A nice everyday lotion that gives smooth, nourished skin.
reviews.zh: 呢款身體乳感覺輕盈，吸收快，唔會留低油膩感。整日都令皮膚保持柔軟同水潤，而且香味好舒服，唔會太濃。係一款好好嘅日常身體乳，令皮膚幼滑、滋潤。

reviews.text: This body lotion feels incredibly light yet nourishing, leaving my skin soft and hydrated all day. The pink grapefruit scent is refreshing and uplifting without being overpowering. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any sticky residue, making it perfect for daily use. My skin feels smooth, healthy, and pleasantly scented. A simple but effective addition to any skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 呢款身體乳感覺極之輕盈但又滋養，令皮膚一整日都柔軟、水潤。粉紅西柚嘅香味清新提神，而且唔會太濃。吸收快，唔會留低任何黏膩嘅殘留，非常適合日常使用。皮膚感覺幼滑、健康，香味都令人舒服。係任何護膚程序都好簡單但有效嘅新增產品。

reviews.text: I love the baby powder scent and have bought many bottles, so when it wasn't available I thought I'd try the soap scent. It's a good lotion but this scent is too strong. Luckily it doesn't linger much.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意爽身粉香味，買過好多樽，所以當冇貨嗰時，我就諗住試吓肥皂香味。呢款身體乳幾好，但係呢個香味太濃。幸好佢唔會留好耐。

reviews.text:
This lotion is very hydrating, smells very nice and makes your skin feels so soft. I purchased the White Musk scent (and it smells heavenly, it smells very sweet, like a sweet chocolate?), and my current one is Cherry Blossom, which is the same but stronger perfumed scent. 

 Give the cream 5 to 10 minutes for it to stop being sticky! It glides and absorbs very fast, however.
reviews.zh:
呢款身體乳補水效果好好、香味好好聞，令皮膚感覺好柔軟。我買咗白麝香（White Musk）味，佢聞落好似天堂咁香，好甜，好似甜朱古力咁（？），而我而家用緊櫻花味，同樣嘅香味，但係香味更加濃。

塗完之後等 5 至 10 分鐘，先會唔再黏！不過佢推開同吸收都好快。

reviews.text: Ho comprato questa crema incuriosita dei prodotti giapponesi, già dalla scatola si sente il profumo (ylang ylang) La confezione con il Dispert consente di dosare molto bene la crema. È un prodotto idratante, Non troppo denso né appiccicoso, da lieve profumo che poi piano piano scompare. La quantità è notevole e per il prezzo decisamente ottima! Ho la pelle del corpo molto sensibile che tende a seccare, vedremo nel tempo. Per ora la super consiglio!!
reviews.zh: 我係因為好奇日本產品而買呢款面霜，單係盒子已經聞到香味（依蘭）。包裝配備咗 Dispert（分配器），可以好準確咁控制份量。呢款係保濕產品，唔會太稠，都唔黏，香味淡淡，然後慢慢消散。份量好多，以呢個價錢嚟講絕對好抵！我嘅身體皮膚好敏感，容易乾，等時間會話俾你知。而家我好推薦！！

reviews.text: I got a sample of this in the baby powder scent when I had made a previous order. I don't use lotion much so I gave it to my mother. She loved it! She wouldn't stop talking about it for weeks and was very disheartened when she ran out of the sample so I bought her the xl size pump bottle for mother's day in that scent. She did mention the scent isn't as strong for the larger size but she loves how luxurious it feels and hydrates her skin.
reviews.zh: 我之前訂過一次單，當時收到一個爽身粉香味嘅試用裝。我唔常用身體乳，所以送俾我媽媽。佢好鍾意！佢連續幾個星期都講個唔停，而且當試用裝用晒嗰時，佢好灰心，所以母親節我買咗大size泵裝、同樣香味俾佢。佢提過大size嗰個香味冇咁濃，但係佢鍾意佢嘅奢華感，同埋佢可以滋潤皮膚。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
